boot_mode.mode_pins: M[2:0]=001 MSPI (schematic p3 literal label '001,MSPI'; R14 1K pull-up on FPGA_M0 installed, R13/R15 NC)
boot_mode.cfg_clk: H13 dedicated CFG_CLK, shared by both flashes, external net SPI_CLK (schematic p3: CFG_CLK next to pin H13)
boot_mode.chip_selects: SPI0_CS (U15) and SPI1_CS (U9) independent nets; Logos2 master SPI has FCS_N and FCS2_N (DS04001 table 4-11) matching dual-flash design
boot_mode.image_layout: bitstream at flash address 0, linear, no padding; 3791112 B ~ 926 x 4K sectors (~3.62 MiB) of 16 MiB; future weight partition suggested at 0x400000 (4K-aligned)
boot_mode.master_spi_timing: CFG_CLK max 40 MHz (low 15.38 MHz, daisy 25 MHz, initial 2.99 MHz); TPL<=11ms TPOR<=71ms TICCK>=400ns (DS04001 table 4-10/4-11)
